name: Shadow Temporal
description: Analyzes shadow movement consistency over time
algorithm: Shadow Temporal — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal shadow consistency for video deepfake detection:

1. **影検出&トラッキング**: Shadows (both cast shadows and attached shadows) are detected per frame and tracked across time. Shadow regions are identified by their characteristic low luminance with preserved chromaticity relative to surrounding areas.

2. **影-光Source一貫性**: Shadow direction and sharpness should be consistent with scene illumination across all frames. The method tracks shadow direction stability — in constant lighting, shadows should remain directionally stable. Temporal shadow direction changes without corresponding light source movement indicate manipulation.

3. **顔影コヒーレンス**: Facial shadows (nose shadow, orbital shadows, chin shadow) should be temporally consistent with scene shadows. The method compares facial shadow dynamics with background shadow behavior. Deepfake face generation may produce facial shadows that evolve differently from scene shadows.

4. **影Intensity安定性**: Shadow intensity (luminance ratio of shadow to illuminated region) should vary smoothly over time. The method tracks shadow intensity — sudden changes in shadow darkness without illumination changes indicate temporal artifacts from frame-independent generation.

5. **Penumbra一貫性**: Shadow edge softness (penumbra width) is determined by light source size and distance. Penumbra should remain consistent across the scene and over time. The method checks penumbra consistency — deepfakes may produce shadows with inconsistent or physically impossible penumbra characteristics.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through shadow temporal analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
